top_signals.title: Antitrust Lawyer on NFL Streaming Cost Concerns
top_signals.summary: Shindor Cantor Lerner Managing Partner Kellie Lerner discusses the rising cost for sports fans to watch their teams through various streaming platforms such as the NFL, and potential legal ramifications for antitrust violations. She speaks to Romaine Bostick on Bloomberg's 'The Close.' (Source: Bloomberg)
